text: The 6 GHz band contains no legacy devices at all, because only Wi-Fi 6E and 7 clients can use it.
explanation: True, and it mandates WPA3. Roughly 1,200 MHz of new unlicensed spectrum, uncrowded and free of legacy rate compatibility burdens — the most significant change to the wireless landscape in twenty years, limited chiefly by having the shortest range of the three bands.
